Fuel

Welcome to Fuel

Fuel is the food half of Overload, now its own app. Your days, targets, favorites and saved meals come across in one step. Nothing is removed from Overload.

You can still bring your log across later, in Settings.

Cloud sync

Sign in to keep your food log in the cloud so it survives clearing this phone and follows you to a new one. Use the same email and password as in Overload: the food log that account holds comes across the first time.
